structured.answer: I didn't pick anything. There are 143 tracks and every company has the same S&P and "מניות" tracks at about 13% (3 years) and around 0.6% fee. If I had to, I'd take an S&P track at a name I know, like מגדל, כלל or הראל, but nothing on the page told me which one.

stuck.where: Screens 3-6, the long list grouped by company
stuck.why: Same track names repeat for every company with almost the same numbers. Nothing stands out and nothing is recommended, so I got bored and stopped at screen 6

stuck.where: Return column, '3 שנים 13.7%' vs 'פחות מ־3 שנים'
stuck.why: Not sure if the % is per year or for all 3 years, and many rows show no number at all

stuck.where: Fee column rows with 'עוד לא דווח' and a warning icon
stuck.why: Looks like a warning. Didn't know if those tracks are risky or just new
